title: CTI framework vocabulary (P169 warninglists, P292 attack_index, P295 actor_alias_index)
notes: Context facts only: warninglist matches never delete or override findings (P169 FC6); ATT&CK 'uses' edges are context, never attribution (P292 FC7); alias equivalences are vendor assessments, not identities (P295 FC7).

attributes.warninglist_matches: list of MISP warninglist matches {list, name, version, version_date, outcome (suppress|tag|top_site), category, match (exact|subdomain|ip_in_range|cidr_contained|cidr_partial_overlap), entry, licence, origin (bundled|downloaded), url}
attributes.warninglist_outcome: P169 outcome for the entity: 'suppress' (known-benign infrastructure, verdicts lowered to POSSIBLE), 'tag' (context only) or 'none'
attributes.warninglists_build: MISP warninglists build that answered {source, commit, built, bundle_sha256, lists, downloaded_lists}
attributes.warninglist_notes: notes of the warninglist evaluation (lists matched but not applied: partial CIDR overlaps, public-suffix parents, user-content parents)
attributes.popular_site: bool: the name itself is on a top-site list (Tranco/Umbrella/Radar top 10k): context only, never a verdict
attributes.reputation_downweight: scope of the reputation down-weight a top-site list grants: 'registrable_domain' (the registrable domain itself only, never URLs, subdomains or hashes)
attributes.user_content_parent: user-content or dynamic-DNS platform the name sits on (e.g. 'sites.google.com', 'duckdns.org'): never suppressed
attributes.attack_id: MITRE ATT&CK id of the card (T1059.001, TA0002, G0007, S0002, C0001, M1036, DET0001)
attributes.attack_name: name of the MITRE ATT&CK object
attributes.attack_kind: kind of the MITRE ATT&CK object: technique, tactic, group, malware, tool, campaign, mitigation or detection
attributes.attack_status: status of a typed ATT&CK id: ok, revoked (see attack_replaced_by) or deprecated
attributes.attack_replaced_by: ATT&CK id that replaces a revoked id (the typed id is kept, never rewritten silently)
attributes.attack_url: attack.mitre.org page of the ATT&CK object
attributes.stix_id: official STIX 2.1 id of the object (e.g. attack-pattern--...): exports reuse it, never a regenerated id
attributes.misp_galaxy_tag: MISP galaxy tag of the object (misp-galaxy:mitre-attack-pattern="PowerShell - T1059.001")
attributes.attack_version: MITRE ATT&CK release of the local index that answered (recorded per case and in report footers)
attributes.attack_index_built: ATT&CK index build {built, versions per domain, missing_domains}
attributes.attack_domains: ATT&CK domains of the object (enterprise-attack, mobile-attack, ics-attack)
attributes.attack_tactics: list of {shortname, name} tactics of a technique, read from the ATT&CK data (never hard-coded)
attributes.attack_platforms: platforms the ATT&CK technique or software applies to
attributes.attack_aliases: aliases ATT&CK records for a group, software or campaign
attributes.attack_parent: parent technique id of an ATT&CK sub-technique
attributes.attack_groups: up to 10 ATT&CK groups {id, name} related to the object ('uses' edges: context, never attribution)
attributes.attack_software: up to 10 ATT&CK software {id, name} related to the object ('uses' edges: context, never attribution)
attributes.attack_mitigations: up to 10 ATT&CK mitigations {id, name} of a technique
attributes.attack_detections: up to 10 ATT&CK detection strategies {id, name} of a technique (x-mitre-detection-strategy)
attributes.attack_campaigns: up to 10 ATT&CK campaigns {id, name} related to the object
attributes.attack_related_totals: total number of related ATT&CK objects per kind (the card lists at most 10)
attributes.attack_alternatives: list of ATT&CK objects a name matched when it matched more than one
attributes.capec_patterns: CAPEC patterns {capec, name, cwe, via, confidence} citing an ATT&CK technique (CWE -> CAPEC -> ATT&CK: low confidence)
attributes.alias_status: alias-index resolution status: ok or ambiguous
attributes.alias_cards: alias-index cards {cluster, canonical, namespace, mitre_ids, malpedia_ids, aliases [{alias, sources, statement}], wording, overlaps_with, countries, sources, source_dates, umbrella}
attributes.alias_alternatives: per namespace (actor, malware): the alternatives line of an ambiguous name ('X: A [ids] (source) / B ...')
attributes.alias_same_name: per namespace: clusters that share the exact name but stay unmerged (no merge on name equality alone)
attributes.alias_note: disambiguation note of the alias resolution (umbrella name, same name in unmerged clusters)
attributes.alias_index_build: alias index build that answered {galaxy_commit, built, downloaded, report_fingerprint}

tags.cloud: the address lies in a published cloud provider range (shared or rented infrastructure: context, reputation still applies)
tags.cdn: the address is a shared CDN edge (many unrelated sites behind it)
tags.datacenter: the address lies in a hosting/datacenter network
tags.dynamic_dns: the name is under a dynamic DNS service (anyone can create names under it): never suppressed
tags.url_shortener: the name is a URL shortener: the destination decides
tags.disposable_mail: the domain is a disposable (throw-away) mailbox provider
tags.user_content_hosting: the name is (on) a platform where anyone can publish content: never suppressed, URLs on it are investigated
tags.popular_site: the name itself is on a top-site list (Tranco/Umbrella/Radar): context only
tags.known_vendor_domain: the name is on a major vendor's domain inventory: context only
tags.umbrella_name: an umbrella actor/malware name vendors use for several groups: candidates only, verify identifiers
tags.sinkholed: the domain resolves to a sinkhole: formerly malicious, hits are infected clients, never live C2

relations.replaced_by: revoked ATT&CK id -> the id that replaces it
relations.used_by: ATT&CK technique or software -> group/software that uses it (context, never attribution)
relations.uses_software: threat actor or campaign -> software it uses according to ATT&CK (context, never attribution)
relations.alias_of: actor/malware name -> canonical name of its alias cluster (vendor assessment, not identity)
